BETA Close X Sage Group PLC announced the purchase of 1,650,089 ordinary shares on 13 May 2026, as part of its share buyback program initiated on 2 March 2026. The highest price paid per share was 875.4000 pence, the lowest was 833.6000 pence, and the volume-weighted average price paid was 857.6300 pence. All purchased shares will be cancelled. Disclaimer* Sage Group PLC (The) 13 May 2026 THE SAGE GROUP PLC TRANSACTION IN OWN SHARES The Sage Group plc ("Sage" or the "Group") announces today that it has purchased the following number of its ordinary shares of 1 4 / 77 pence each on the London Stock Exchange and Multilateral Trading Facilities from J.P. Morgan Securities plc (''JPMS''). This is pursuant to the share buyback programme announced on 2 March 2026 which is expected to end no later than 5 June 2026.
